Mod.Author: Kuraudo
Mod.Name: Dynamic Backgrounds
Mod.Description:
This is a compilation of official and fan-made backgrounds spanning all titles. The aspect ratio is automatically detected as either 4:3 or 16:9. The new game and continue options on the title screen are mainly located in the bottom-left corner. You can choose some background music for the title screen too.
-Special Thanks: Bonez, Chrysalis for new game/continue hext patch
